preToolUse.powershell: if (Get-Command mise -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { mise exec --quiet -- node .agents/hooks/guard.ts copilot }; exit 0

postToolUse.powershell: if (Get-Command mise -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { mise exec --quiet -- node .agents/hooks/edited.ts copilot }; exit 0

agentStop.powershell: if (Get-Command mise -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { mise exec --quiet -- node .agents/hooks/check.ts copilot }; exit 0
